title: Limited short-term impact of lemming grazing on vascular plants under experimentally reduced predation in the High Arctic
habitat_type_comments: NA
comment:
These values are averaged across 3 years, and 2 habitat types.  But only values like this presented. interesting full-factorial with removal of predators and herbivores, but only used herbivore w/ and wo for this.  I am wondering about habitat type: The mesic tundra plant community. 
is dominated by shrubs (mostly Salix arctica, but also Salix
herbacea and Salix reticulata, Dryas integrifolia and Cassiope
tetragona), graminoids (Arctagrostis latifolia, Alopecurus alpinus,
Poa arctica, Luzula confusa, and Luzula nivalis), sedges (Eriophorum
angustifolium, Carex spp.), and herbs (Stellaria longipes,
Oxyria digina, Polygonum viviparum, Potentilla spp., Ranunculus
spp. Pedicularis spp., and Saxifraga spp.).
